cover: Review your forms for people arriving after a loss

slides.title: Why do we need this now?
slides.body: Ask it of every question, and move what can wait to later. Show one group of questions at a time, sized for a phone.

slides.title: Is there somewhere to start?
slides.body: Before an empty text box, offer a few preset phrases. Finding words for someone else’s loss is hard.

slides.title: What does leaving look like?
slides.body: Closing an account should be the member's call. Erasing their details later can leave the memorial they made in place.

slides.title: Will the date be right next year?
slides.body: An anniversary kept on the Hebrew calendar falls on a different date every year. Ask about calendars before you build reminders.

slides.title: Can anything happen on one tap?
slides.body: Nothing important should happen without a chance to stop.

slides.title: Who can see a member’s record?
slides.body: Staff preview the app as a test account that can’t reach real members, and every visit goes in the audit log.
